subject: New phone cannot access employee Wi-Fi or approve sign-in
description: Hi Service Desk, I replaced my phone yesterday. The old phone was factory-reset and returned to the carrier. On the new phone I can sign in to email, but the employee Wi-Fi never appears and approval prompts still go to the retired authenticator. I installed the company portal but it says Setup incomplete. I restarted twice and tried the guest network. Can you help before my shift tomorrow?
